home_subtitle: Flights, staffing, assignments and attendance in one place.
login_description: Use your ID number and the sign-in code issued to you.
login_id_digits: ID number must contain digits only.
login_quote: Flights, staffing, and attendance in one operational picture.
dashboard_placeholder: The coverage dashboard will appear here.
employees_description: Everyone on the staff list. Open a card for the full profile; switch to “Move between teams” to drag people into teams.
employees_deactivated: {name} was deactivated and removed from their team. They are now shown under Inactive.
employees_move_description: Drag employees from the list into a team to assign them. Drag a team member back to the list to remove them from the team.
auth_forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
login_password_digits: The code must contain digits only.
login_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait 15 minutes and try again.
login_locked: This account is locked after too many wrong codes. Ask an administrator for a new code.
login_code_expired: Your sign-in code has expired. Ask an administrator for a new one.
api_invalid_token: The refresh token is invalid or has expired. Sign in again.
users_description: Admins and operations managers who can sign in. Sign-in codes are shown once; give them to the account holder in person.
users_issue_code_description: The current code stops working and {name} is signed out everywhere.
users_issue_own_code_description: Your current code stops working. You stay signed in on this device.
users_change_role_description: The new permissions apply on {name}'s next request.
users_create_description: The account signs in with its ID number and the code shown after you create it.
users_code_hint: Shown only once. Give it to the account holder in person; it isn't stored anywhere readable.
users_error_duplicate: This ID number already has an account.
users_error_role: Choose a role that can sign in.
users_error_self: You can't do this to your own account.
users_error_last_admin: There must always be at least one active admin.
users_error_inactive: Activate the account before issuing a code.
users_deactivated: {name} was signed out and can no longer sign in.
teams_description: Teams are assigned to flights as a unit. A team can work many flights a day, but never two overlapping ones.
teams_create_description: Give the team an English and an Arabic name.
teams_rename_description: The new name appears on the flights table and the report.
teams_error_duplicate: A team with this English name already exists.
teams_deactivated: Team {name} was deactivated and its members unassigned.
staff_employee_no_digits: Employee number must contain digits only.
staff_error_duplicate: An employee with this number already exists.
staff_deactivated: {name} was deactivated and removed from their team.
imports_description: Upload staff or flight data, review every row, then commit once the preview looks right.
imports_upload_description: Choose what the file contains and upload an .xlsx or Markdown table.
imports_file_hint: Up to 2 MB and 2,000 rows. .xlsx, .md or .markdown.
imports_templates_description: Start from the expected columns to avoid mapping mistakes.
imports_history_description: Previews stay open until you commit them. Committed imports are read-only.
imports_error_too_large: The file is larger than 2 MB.
imports_error_too_many_rows: The file has more than 2,000 data rows.
imports_error_empty: The file has no table or no data rows.
imports_error_unreadable: The file could not be read. Check that it opens in Excel.
imports_error_conflict: A row conflicts with existing data. Re-upload the file after fixing it.
imports_error_invalid_employee_no: Employee number must contain digits only.
imports_error_duplicate_in_file: This row appears more than once in the file.
imports_error_unknown_function: Unknown function. Add it first or use an existing name.
imports_error_unknown_team: Unknown or inactive team. Check the name.
imports_commit_success: Import committed: {created} created, {updated} updated, {skipped} skipped, {errors} errors.
imports_rows_description: Rows with errors are skipped. Everything else is applied when you commit.
imports_no_rows: No data rows in this file.
imports_nothing_to_commit: There is nothing to commit in this preview.
error_not_found: This page or record doesn't exist.
error_internal: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
error_conflict: This change conflicts with another record. Reload and try again.
settings_description: Airport-wide settings. Only admins can change them.
roster_pattern_description: The team's repeating pattern of shifts and days off. A change takes effect from the date you choose; earlier days keep their pattern.
roster_personal_description: Admin staff and supervisors can follow their own pattern. On its dates it replaces the team's and the department's pattern.
roster_end_description: From the date you choose, this person follows their team's cycle again.
roster_cycle_hint_cycle: Pick a shift, then tap days to paint them. Or drag a shift onto a day, drag days to reorder, and drag a day to the bin to remove it. Type a one-letter code, or − for Off.
roster_cycle_hint_weekly: Pick a shift, then tap days to paint them. Or drag a shift onto a day, or a day onto another to swap them. Type a one-letter code, or − for Off.
roster_drop_full: The cycle is full: {max} days at most.
roster_drop_last_day: A cycle keeps at least one day.
roster_drop_add: Add a day with the selected shift
roster_drop_bin: Drop a day here to remove it
roster_drag_day: Enter paints this day with the selected shift. Space picks it up; the arrow keys move it, Space drops it, Escape cancels.
roster_drag_shift: Enter selects this shift. Space picks it up to drop on a day; the arrow keys move it, Space drops it, Escape cancels.
roster_cycle_too_long: A cycle has at most {max} days.
roster_cycle_needs_work: A pattern needs at least one shift.
roster_weekly_days: A weekly pattern has 7 days, Sunday to Saturday.
roster_field_anchor_description: The cycle repeats from this date, forwards and backwards.
roster_field_effective_from_description: A past date recomputes the days from then to today. Days before keep the old cycle.
roster_pattern_ended: {name} follows the team's cycle from the chosen date.
roster_error_effective_too_old: Choose a date from the last {max} days, or later.
roster_error_overlap: Another change to this cycle was saved at the same time. Reload and try again.
roster_error_no_personal: This person has no own cycle on or after that date.
roster_error_supervisor_exists: This person already supervises the team.
roster_error_supervisor_not_found: That supervisor isn't on this team any more.
roster_preview_empty: Nobody is in this team in these four weeks.
roster_preview_legend: Shift codes in their colour · 🌙 night shift · O Off · H Holiday · A Absent · * changed for that day · ⇄ moved by a swap · · not in this team. Unsaved changes show here before you save.
roster_supervisors_description: Staff who supervise this team. They can't sign in yet.
roster_members_description: Everyone in the team during the preview, including scheduled moves.
staff_employee_no_hint: Leave empty to give the new employee the next free number.
departments_description: The department tree. Copied from Odoo once, then managed here.
departments_create_description: Add a department or a sub-department.
departments_edit_description: Change the name, parent or manager of {name}.
departments_error_duplicate: Another department with this name already exists here.
departments_error_cycle: A department cannot be placed under itself or one of its sub-departments.
departments_error_has_staff: Move the active employees to another department first.
departments_error_has_children: Deactivate or move its active sub-departments first.
departments_error_manager: Choose an active employee as manager.
departments_error_manager_overlap: Another manager change for this department was saved at the same time. Reload and try again.
management_description: Who manages each department and supervises each team on a date, and what still needs someone.
management_gaps_description: Fix these so everyone has someone responsible for them.
management_gap_department_without_manage: {department} has no manager, and no department above it has one.
management_gap_supervisor_outside_branch: {person} supervises {team} but works outside its department.
management_structure_description: Departments, their managers, teams and supervisors on {date}.
management_unplaced_description: Give these teams a department on their team page so they have a manager.
management_empty_description: Add departments first, then set their managers here.
management_change_manager_description: Who manages {name}, and from which date. The previous manager stays in the history.
management_no_manager_hint: Optional. With no manager, the nearest manager above covers this department.
management_tree_reports_to_description: Who is responsible for {name} on {date}, nearest first.
management_tree_manages_description: {count} people below {name} on {date}. Open a manager or supervisor to see their people.
management_tree_hr_hint: Approves last and can always act directly.
management_error_unchanged: Nothing changes: this is already the department's manager from that date.
settings_shifts_description: Each shift has its own start and end time, set on the Shifts page.
roster_type_cycle_description: 1 to 28 days that repeat from day 1, forwards and backwards.
roster_type_weekly_description: The same shift on the same weekday, Sunday to Saturday.
shifts_description: Every shift people can be rostered on. A shift whose end is at or before its start ends the next day.
shifts_create_description: Code, name and times. Off is not a shift: leave a pattern day empty instead.
shifts_deactivated: Shift {name} was deactivated. Saved patterns keep it; new ones can't use it.
shifts_locked_explanation: This shift is already used by a pattern, an override or a punch, so its code, times, break, required minutes and windows can't change. Create a new shift for other times.
shifts_field_code_description: 1 to 3 capital letters or digits, shown on the roster. OFF is reserved.
shifts_field_required_description: Empty: the length minus the break.
shifts_code_invalid: Use 1 to 3 capital letters or digits.
shifts_code_reserved: OFF is reserved for days off.
shifts_time_invalid: Enter a time as HH:mm, from 00:00 to 23:59.
shifts_error_duplicate: Another shift already has this code.
shifts_error_locked: This shift is in use, so this can't change. Create a new shift instead.
attendance_entry_description: Type check-in and check-out times for a day. A check-out earlier than the check-in is the next day. Nothing is saved until you press Save.
attendance_pick_scope: Choose a department or a team
attendance_nobody_planned: Nobody is planned on this day. Use + add person for someone who worked anyway.
attendance_absence_and_times: An absence can't have punch times.
attendance_issue_overlap: Overlaps another punch pair of this person.
attendance_issue_future: A time is in the future.
attendance_issue_outside_window: These times don't fit the planned shift.
attendance_issue_unplanned: Day off: saved as day-off work.
attendance_error_rows: {count} problems: nothing was saved. Fix the marked rows.
attendance_error_empty: Nothing to save: no times or absences were entered.
attendance_error_person: This person is unknown or inactive.
attendance_error_absence_overlap: Someone already has an absence on this day. Reload and try again.
attendance_error_already_corrected: This punch was already corrected. Correct the newest one.
attendance_day_description: Click a day in the preview. Corrections keep the original, struck through, with the reason.
attendance_corrected_saved: Correction saved; the original is kept.
attendance_removed_saved: Punch removed; the original is kept in the history.
attendance_time_required: Enter the new time, or tick Remove.
patterns_error_duplicate: A pattern with this English name already exists.
patterns_error_locked: This pattern is in use, so its days and type can't change. Use “Change from a date”.
patterns_error_inactive: This pattern is inactive. Activate it before assigning it.
patterns_error_type_changed: Keep the pattern's type. Build a new pattern for the other type.
patterns_error_nothing_follows: No employee, team or department follows this pattern on or after that date.
assign_error_target_not_found: A chosen employee, team or department doesn't exist.
assign_error_target_inactive: A chosen employee, team or department is inactive.
assign_error_nothing_to_end: Nothing to end: no pattern is assigned here on or after that date.
schedule_rule_required: Set own off days or a crew start.
schedule_error_nothing_to_reset: This employee has no own off days or crew start on or after that date.
assign_ended: Back to the team or department pattern from that date.
assign_impact_crew_starts: Start at their own crew start
assign_impact_own_pattern: Have an own pattern, which still wins
assign_preview_hint: See who it applies to before saving. Nothing is saved.
departments_assign_description: Every team and employee in {name} and its sub-departments follows it, unless a team or own pattern wins.
patterns_deactivated: {name} deactivated. Who follows it keeps it until changed.
patterns_description: Reusable work patterns. Build one once, then assign it to employees, teams or departments from a date.
patterns_edit_from_date_description: Saves a copy with these days. Everyone following this pattern moves to the copy from the date; earlier days stay as they were.
patterns_edit_from_date_hint: A past date (last 400 days) recomputes the days from then to today.
patterns_edit_from_date_submit: Save the copy and move followers
patterns_edited_from: Saved. Followers use the new days from {date}.
patterns_empty_description: Build a pattern once, then assign it to employees, teams or departments.
patterns_empty_filtered: No pattern is followed in this department.
patterns_field_default_work: Shift on a worked off day
patterns_field_default_work_description: When an employee's own off days fall elsewhere, they work the pattern's off days with this shift.
patterns_preset_nights_days_24_8: 12 h from 08:00: 4 N, 4 off, 4 D, 4 off, 4 D, 4 off (24 days)
patterns_presets_missing_hint: Greyed-out presets need a shift that doesn't exist yet: hover them to see which.
patterns_step_1_description: A weekly pattern repeats Sunday to Saturday; a cycle repeats every N days.
patterns_step_2_description: Pick a shift and tap days, or drag shifts and days.
patterns_step_3_description: Who follows it, and from when. You can also assign it later.
patterns_used_explanation: This pattern is in use: its days and type are read-only. Change it from a date to keep the past as it was.
person_assign_description: {name} follows this pattern from the date, instead of their team's or department's.
person_back_to_team_description: Ends this employee's own pattern from the date; then the team's or department's applies.
person_follows_none: No pattern applies today: the days are off.
person_no_own_rules: No own off days or crew start.
person_schedule_description: What plans this employee's days today, and their own rules.
person_use_own_pattern: Use an own pattern from a date
schedule_description: Own off days apply to weekly patterns, a crew start to cycles. Each change starts on a date and keeps the past.
schedule_field_crew_start_description: The day of the team's cycle this employee is on when the cycle starts.
schedule_field_off_days_description: Days this employee is off every week. The pattern's other off days become work days.
schedule_reset_description: End the own off days and crew start from a date.
schedule_reset_done: Own rules end on that date.
schedule_history_description: Each line is a period in which the plan and the own rules stay the same, newest first. Swaps are one-off days, listed under their period.
schedule_history_empty: No plan has reached this employee yet.
staffing_caption: People on each shift, per day
staffing_description: People per shift each day, from the plan.
team_assign_description: Every member of {name} follows it from the date, except members with an own pattern.
team_members_description: Current members and members joining later.
team_schedule_description: The pattern the members follow, and a preview of their days.
team_schedule_none: No pattern today: members follow their department, or are off.
assign_preview_stale: The choice changed since this preview: preview again.
profile_description: Personal details HR keeps in this app. Nothing here is sent to Odoo.
profile_names_description: First and last name in each language, job title and personal email. When both parts of a language are filled, the full name shown everywhere becomes "first last".
profile_names_hint: Fill both parts of a language, or leave both empty to keep the current full name.
profile_name_part_missing: Enter both the first and the last name, or leave both empty.
profile_identity_description: Parents' names, the national ID card and the passport.
profile_document_number_invalid: Use letters, digits and dashes only.
profile_id_expiry_before_issue: The expiry date can't be before the issue date.
profile_handle_hint: A username such as @name, or the full link.
profile_experience_no_start_date: No start date here, so only earlier jobs count.
profile_experience_dates_order: The end date can't be before the start date.
profile_skill_no_options: Every active skill is already given. Create one with "New skill" in the list.
profile_error_skill_duplicate: This person already has this skill.
profile_documents_empty: No document types yet. Create one with "New document type".
profile_document_received_on_required: Enter the date it was received.
staff_name_parts_hint: This person has no first and last name yet. Add them on the profile's Personal tab.
staff_lists_required_hint: Counts toward "received X of Y required" on every profile.
staff_lists_error_duplicate: An item with this English name already exists.
profile_custody_issued_required: Enter the date it was handed out.
profile_custody_status_on_required: Enter the date of this condition.
profile_custody_dates_order: This date can't be before the hand-out date.
staff_lists_manage_description: Add, rename or deactivate items. Items are never deleted: a deactivated item leaves the pickers but stays on the people who have it.
employee_new_description: The initials follow the names you type.
employee_new_after_save: Contacts, experience, skills, documents and custody are added on the profile after saving.
employee_new_required_legend: Fields marked * are required; the others can be filled now or later on the profile.
employee_new_identity_hint: Names as written on the ID card, in English and Arabic.
employee_new_family_hint: The ID number is required; parents' names and the other ID details are optional.
employee_new_job_hint: When they start, and where they work.
employee_new_contact_hint: How to reach them. Odoo sends attendance emails to the work email.
daily_error_recompute_range: Pick a date from the last 400 days, up to today.
pattern_pay_rate_invalid: Enter a rate from {min} to {max}, with two decimals at most.
pattern_pay_needs_value: Set at least one value, or use Reset to go back to the defaults.
pattern_pay_error_nothing_to_reset: This pattern has no pay rule on or after that date.
pattern_pay_error_overlap: Another pay rule of this pattern starts on these dates. Reload and try again.
pattern_dates_order: The last day can't be before the first.
pattern_holiday_too_long: A holiday lasts at most {max} days.
pattern_holiday_error_overlap: This pattern already has a holiday on one of these dates.
pattern_mission_error_not_following: Don't follow this pattern on every date: {names}.
pattern_mission_error_absent: Already away on one of these dates: {names}.
pattern_mission_error_overlap: Someone in this mission got an absence on these dates meanwhile. Reload and try again.
daily_recompute_description: Works out the stored daily attendance again, from this date to today, for everyone active and anyone with punches. At most {max} days.
daily_recompute_done: Recomputed: {written} days written, {kept} unchanged, {logLines} log lines.
patterns_month_assigned_none: Not assigned to anyone in this month.
patterns_month_empty: Nobody followed this pattern in this month.
patterns_month_followed_description: Everyone whose days this pattern planned in the month (a personal pattern or a nearer team plan wins over it).
patterns_month_grid_description: Every day of the month for these people. ⇄ marks a swap, * a day edit.
patterns_month_changes_none: No swaps or day edits this month.
pattern_pay_description: How extra time of the people who follow this pattern is paid, as a multiple of each person's own hourly pay. An empty value uses the company setting, then the built-in default.
pattern_pay_versions_none: No pay rule of its own: it inherits every value.
pattern_pay_sheet_description: A new version from the date you pick; the days before keep the old rule. Leave a value empty to use the company default.
pattern_pay_from_hint: A past date (last 400 days) recomputes the days from then to today. Days before keep the old rule.
pattern_pay_reset_description: From this date the company defaults apply again. Changes planned after it are removed.
pattern_holiday_description: A holiday is an off day for everyone who follows this pattern. Whoever still works it gets a one-off shift.
pattern_holiday_sheet_description: Up to 14 days. Past dates are allowed with a reason.
pattern_holiday_field_ot_hint: On: every minute worked that day is paid at the holiday rate. Off: a paid day off, and time worked shows as unpaid extra.
pattern_holiday_cancel_description: {name} ({dates}) stops being a holiday; those days follow the pattern again.
pattern_mission_description: A mission is a full paid day away for the people you pick: no overtime and no shortage.
pattern_mission_sheet_description: Everyone you pick must follow this pattern on every date and not be away already. Past dates are allowed with a reason.
pattern_mission_no_candidates: Nobody follows this pattern around today.
pattern_mission_cancel_description: {names} ({dates}): those days follow the roster again.
settings_pay_description: The overtime rule and holidays every pattern inherits. A pattern can override them on its own tabs.
company_pay_description: The overtime rule every pattern inherits. A pattern's own values win over these; an empty value uses the built-in default.
company_pay_versions_none: No company setting yet: the built-in defaults apply.
company_holiday_description: Holidays for everyone who follows a pattern. A pattern can skip one, or change its overtime switch, on its Holidays tab; a pattern's own holiday on the same date wins.
pattern_company_holidays_description: Set in Settings for every pattern. Skip one for this pattern, or change its overtime switch.
pattern_exception_description: {dates}. Skip it so this pattern's people work the day as planned, or keep it and choose its overtime switch.
patterns_created_pay_hint: Set this pattern's overtime and holidays on its tabs.
daily_description: The stored attendance record of each person for one day: worked time, late time and overtime with its rate. Edit a day to set leave, sick or another state; History shows every change and where it came from.
daily_person_hint: Type a name or employee number.
daily_rows_description: One row per person and day. Every person in this scope has a stored record for these days.
daily_missing: One row per person and day. {count} person-days in this scope have no stored record yet: Recompute these days creates them.
daily_none_stored: No stored records for these days and this scope yet.
daily_unpaid_ot_off: Overtime is off for this pattern.
daily_unpaid_holiday_not_eligible: The holiday is not overtime-eligible: a paid day off.
daily_unpaid_absence: The day has a full-day state: punches count for nothing.
day_tag_guide_description: What each tag on this page means. Click a tag in the table to read about it.
day_tag_status_expected_help: Has a shift that has not started yet, or is still inside the grace minutes. No check-in yet.
day_tag_status_present_help: Checked in on time (inside the grace minutes) and still at work. Worked time is counted at check-out.
day_tag_status_late_help: Checked in more than the grace minutes after the shift start and still at work. The Late column shows the minutes from the shift start.
day_tag_status_on_break_help: Checked in and started a break that has not ended yet.
day_tag_status_done_help: Checked in and out. Worked time and overtime are counted.
day_tag_status_missing_help: Has a shift, the grace minutes have passed, and there is no check-in.
day_tag_status_missing_action: Type the punches on the entry sheet, or set a state (Leave, Sick…) with Edit day.
day_tag_status_off_help: No shift and no punches on this day.
day_tag_status_unscheduled_help: Punches on a day with no shift. All worked time counts as overtime (work on an off day).
day_tag_state_leave_help: A full-day leave, set with Edit day. Nothing is required, and punches on this day count for nothing.
day_tag_state_sick_help: A full-day sick day, set with Edit day. Nothing is required, and punches on this day count for nothing.
day_tag_state_no_show_help: Marked absent for the whole day, with Edit day. Punches on this day count for nothing.
day_tag_state_mission_help: A pattern mission. Nothing is required, and punches on this day count for nothing.
day_tag_state_mission_action: Missions are set and cleared on the pattern's Missions tab, not with Edit day.
day_tag_state_other_help: Another full-day state, with its reason in the day's History. Punches on this day count for nothing.
day_tag_mark_holiday_help: A holiday of the pattern or the company. Nothing is required; work on it counts as overtime when the holiday allows overtime.
day_tag_mark_late_help: The day is finished, but the check-in was later than the shift's grace minutes. The time is the lateness from the shift start.
day_tag_mark_swap_on_help: Works this day because of an approved swap. It is paid as the swap says: a normal day or overtime.
day_tag_mark_swap_off_help: Off this day because of an approved swap.
day_tag_mark_unauth_swap_help: Worked a planned off day with no approved swap or change behind it. It is shown, not penalised.
day_tag_mark_corrected_help: A check-in or check-out of this day was corrected after it was entered.
day_tag_mark_corrected_action: Open History on this row to see who changed what, and when.
day_tag_mark_flagged_help: A recompute failed after a change, so these figures may be out of date.
day_tag_mark_flagged_action: It is repaired when the page loads; Recompute these days also fixes it.
day_tag_source_typed_help: This time was typed on the entry sheet.
day_tag_source_punch_reading_help: This time came from a punch-file import.
day_tag_source_odoo_seed_help: This time came from the one-time import from Odoo.
day_tag_source_next_day_help: This time is on the calendar day after the shift date (an overnight shift).
day_tag_ot_paid_help: Overtime paid at the rate shown (for example ×1.5).
day_tag_ot_unpaid_help: Extra time that is not paid as overtime.
day_state_now_none: This day has no state: it follows the roster.
day_state_set_hint: For one day or a range. Punches stay but count for nothing while a day has a state.
day_punches_hint: Type the day's check-in and check-out, or fill them from the shift and adjust. A changed time is saved as a correction; the original punch stays.
day_punches_none: No punches on this day yet.
day_punches_reason_hint: Required. Saved with the punches and shown in History.
day_punches_failed: Could not load the day's punches.
day_punches_has_state: This day has a full-day state, so punches count for nothing. Clear the state first.
day_punches_several: This day has several check-in / out pairs. Correct each one on the employee page.
day_punches_unchanged: Nothing changed: the times are the same as recorded.
day_state_clear_hint: Removes every state on these dates; the days follow the roster again. A state that goes past the dates keeps its other days.
day_state_reason_hint: Kept with the state only: never copied into the history.
day_state_error_overlap: These dates already have a state: {dates}. Clear it first.
day_state_error_overlap_saved: Another state was saved on these dates meanwhile. Reload and try again.
day_state_error_none: These dates have no state to clear.
day_state_error_pattern_mission: These dates are part of a pattern mission: cancel it on the pattern's Holidays & missions tab.
day_history_description: Every change to the day of {name}, newest first ·
day_history_empty: Nothing recorded for this day yet.
day_history_failed: The history could not be loaded (error {status}).
daily_error_range: Recompute these days covers at most {max} days up to today: narrow the dates.
daily_recompute_days_done: Recomputed {people} people: {written} days written, {kept} unchanged, {logLines} log lines.
swaps_description: Self swaps and swaps between employees. A request changes the roster only once it is approved.
swaps_none: No swaps here for this month.
swap_form_description: The preview shows what the swap does to each day. The roster changes only when the swap is approved.
swap_field_emp_first: Swap date (A works, B is off)
swap_field_pay_as_ot: Pay the moved work day as overtime
swap_pay_as_ot_hint: Unticked: it is paid as a normal work day.
swap_reason_hint: Kept with the request; not copied to the audit log.
swap_saved_pending: Swap request saved: it waits for approval.
swap_saved_approved: Swap saved and approved: the roster changed.
swap_preview_waiting: Pick the people and the dates to see what the swap does.
swap_preview_clashes: {count} other pending request(s) touch the same person and day: only the first one approved applies.
swap_detail_none: It made no change to the roster.
swap_detail_missing: This swap request was not found.
swap_note_hint_reject: Required: why the request is refused.
swap_cancel_hint_pending: Withdraws the request; the roster does not change.
swap_cancel_hint_approved: Cancels its one-off shifts together: both people's days follow the roster again and are recomputed.
swap_error_other_same: B must be someone other than A.
swap_error_second_required: A self swap needs the off day that becomes work.
swap_error_note_required: Write why the request is rejected.
swap_error_changed: The roster or the request changed meanwhile: reload and check again.
swap_error_not_pending: This request is no longer pending.
swap_error_closed: This request is already rejected or cancelled.
swap_issue_same_date: The two dates are the same.
swap_issue_missing_date: A self swap needs the off day.
swap_issue_scope_week: The two dates are not in the same week (Sunday to Saturday).
swap_issue_scope_month: The two dates are not in the same month.
swap_issue_a_not_working: A is not working on the first date.
swap_issue_a_not_off: A is not off on the return date.
swap_issue_b_not_working: B is not working on the return date.
swap_issue_b_not_off: B is not off on the swap date.
swap_issue_o_not_off: A is not off on the off day.
swap_issue_absence: A day of the swap has a state (leave, sick, …).
swap_issue_override: A day of the swap already has a one-off change or another swap.
swap_issue_holiday: A day of the swap is a holiday.
swap_issue_inactive: A person of the swap is not active.
swap_new_description: Pick the people, then tap the days in their roster below. The preview shows what the swap does; the roster changes only when the swap is approved.
swap_roster_title: Who works and who is off
swap_roster_description: Each person's roster this month: shift codes are work days, O is off. Tap a day to set the date picked below.
swap_roster_waiting: Pick person A to see the roster.
jobs_description: The job titles HR picks when creating or editing an employee. Jobs are never deleted: a deactivated job leaves the picker but stays on the people who have it.
jobs_deactivated_keep: {name} was deactivated. {count} active people keep this job.
jobs_empty_hint: Change the search or the filter, or add a new job.
jobs_holders_description: People with this job. Open a profile to change someone's job.
people_more_matches: {count} more: type to narrow the list
departments_staff_description: {count} active employees whose department is this one. Sub-departments have their own list.
departments_staff_empty: No active employees in this department.
day_punches_planned_off: Day off: these punches count as day-off work.
swap_issue_same_shift: That is already the planned shift for this day.
imports_error_punch_range: The file covers more than {days} days. Split it by month.
imports_error_stale: Something changed since the preview (a punch, a full-day state or the roster). Upload the file again to see the new preview.
imports_error_not_undoable: Only a committed punch import can be undone.
imports_error_import_corrected: Someone corrected punches of this import since it was saved. Undo those corrections by hand first.
imports_undo_description: Every punch it brought in is voided and every full-day state it added is cancelled, then the days are recomputed. The batch stays in the history.
imports_punch_balance: Every line has one outcome: {lines} lines = {imported} to import + {skipped} skipped + {refused} refused + {empty} empty.
imports_punch_reasons_title: Why lines were skipped or refused
imports_punch_written: Saved: {events} punches, {absences} full-day states. Undone: {voided} punches voided, {cancelled} states cancelled.
imports_punch_reason_unknown_person: No person with this employee number
imports_punch_reason_inactive_person: The person is archived in the app
imports_punch_reason_no_roster_day: No roster day for the date
imports_punch_reason_overlap: Overlaps another punch of the person
imports_punch_reason_already_absent: The person already has a full-day state that day
imports_punch_reason_state_conflict: A different full-day state on the same day
imports_punch_reason_bad_state: Unknown state (use sick, leave or mission)
imports_punch_reason_state_with_times: Times and a state on one line: put them on two lines
imports_punch_reason_duplicate: A copy of another line (within 60 seconds)
imports_punch_warning_state_with_punches: Full-day state on a day the file also punches
imports_error_shift_used: Shift {code} is used by a pattern, day edit or swap, so it stays active. Undo the roster first.
imports_error_roster_dates: The date columns must be consecutive days of one month (YYYY-MM-DD).
imports_error_roster_mismatch: The fitted roster does not give the file on every day, so nothing was saved.
imports_error_roster_has_punches: A punch import was saved on these dates. Undo it first.
imports_roster_commit_success: Saved the roster of {people} people with {patterns} patterns.
imports_reason_same_as_app: Already in the app with the same times
imports_reason_code_taken: The code exists with other times
imports_reason_not_in_team: Not in this team during the month
imports_reason_unknown_shift: A shift code the app doesn't have (import the shifts first)
imports_reason_group_has_roster: The group already has a roster in this month
imports_reason_person_has_roster: The person already has own rules, day edits or swaps in this month
imports_reason_team_has_roster: The person's team has a roster in this month, and it comes first
imports_reason_pattern_name_taken: A pattern with this name already exists
imports_roster_ok: Replay: every planned day gives the file.
imports_roster_not_ok: Replay: some days differ from the file, so the roster can't be saved.
imports_roster_unlisted: +{count} not in the file, planned by the pattern too
imports_roster_group_joined: Joins the pattern already saved for this month: {name}
imports_roster_written: Undone: {patterns} patterns deactivated, {assignments} assignments and {rules} own rules removed, {dayEdits} day edits and {swaps} swaps cancelled.
day_tag_credit_friday_prayer_help: A planned work day on a Friday with two punch segments. The prayer credit is paid and counts toward the required time; it is never overtime. Any credit left over after a shortage is paid as extra time.
attendance_rules_description: Overtime rounding and the Friday Prayer credit. Each version applies from its start date until the next one starts. A day keeps the rules in force on its date.
attendance_rules_history_empty: No version yet: the built-in defaults apply to every day.
attendance_rules_add_description: The new version applies from the date you pick. The version before it ends the day before that date.
attendance_rules_saved: Version from {date} saved. Days from that date are recomputed.
attendance_rules_error_prayer_segments: Enter a whole number from 1 to 10.
attendance_rules_error_same_date: A version already starts on this date.
attendance_rules_error_later: A later version exists: pick a date after it.
